panel_description_zh: 中景平视，妻子倾身向前；表情委屈（眉上挑反向、嘴撅起颤、一脸被欺负）；头发完全散。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 我是真看出来了，xx就是一个贱人。之前就是我眼瞎，没看出她到底是什么货色。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman on the grey sofa leaning her body forward toward the camera, weight on the front edge of the cushion. Tantrum self-pity expression, wetness pooling at the lower lid and lashes stuck together, eye corners red, eyebrows drawn up and together in the about-to-angry configuration (opposite of anger direction), mouth pushed forward into a trembling pout with lower lip pushed out and quivering, upper lip curled slightly inward, child-like protest face not a snarl. Long straight black hair completely down, single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline. fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible. The other hand clutching her own chest through the fabric. Warm yellow-white living room light, the TV-backlight glow soft behind her. Mood: the victim mask, the 'I am the wounded one' face. Text watermark 'P13-PN02' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: eyes wide open in anger, snarling mouth, anime-style fountain tears with crossed arms, perfectly composed hair, smirk underneath the tears, husband visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, friend/girlfriend character visible, romantic soft lighting

render_constraints_check.character_anchors_referenced_inline: 妻子 wardrobe_default + face_features（长直黑发完全散）+ 妻子_撒泼 expression_signature（眼半挤泪 + 眉上挑反向 + 嘴撅颤 + 一手叉胸）+ motion_anchors（手指指向）
